description: Go server drains a stream in flight; the JS client (started with reconnect enabled -- coordination contract with conformance/runner: the runner passes connect.reconnect={enabled:true} only for this scenario and the two application_close* scenarios, since every other scenario relies on the JS adapter's default one-shot maxAttempts:0) sees drain, the survivor stream is RESET with CANCEL, and the connection closes with GOING_AWAY/4012. MixerClient's own reconnect loop then redials the same listener and the adapter surfaces that as `reconnected` (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 1.2, coordination contract (b)). A fresh stream opened after reconnecting round-trips normally, proving the new connection is fully usable rather than just re-established.
